purpose: Protected assessment-service design contract. This file does not contain production answer keys.

assessment_types.use: Route learner to foundation, standard or accelerated learning.
Confirm understanding and trigger targeted remediation.
Test escalation, fraud/cyber recognition and role-appropriate decisions.

production_rules: Answer keys must live in a protected assessment service, not in the public repository or browser bundle.
Question versions and scoring rules must be auditable.
Regulatory questions must carry jurisdiction and review-date metadata.
A failed assessment should trigger automated remediation before repeat assessment.
Assessment appeals are routed to a human governance gate.
